snippet.title: Sonic XA v0.5 AutoDemo (Running on a real PlayStation 1)
snippet.description: This video is a direct recording from a PlayStation 1 running Sonic XA v0.5 (SAGE 2025 build), using a capture dongle and a composite A/V cable, hence the image looking low on quality. These demos play if you let the title screen run without input for a few seconds.
